supraorbital_contour.structural_silhouette: strongly M-shaped with a distinct central depression
supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: Visible extension of the supraorbital ridge beyond the lateral orbital margins.

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: High contrast between the light-toned (pale/pinkish) muzzle and the dark-toned (black/dark brown) periocular and temporal regions.

other_distinctive_markers: Dense dark pigmentation spots (freckling) on the bridge of the nose and upper maxillary region.
